answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint keys that mirror one honest miner and flood attest queues. Mechanism: a ridge bond gate requires each new identity to lock 0.22 POA for 84h and publish a device-cluster fingerprint; clone #5+ from the same cluster pays a 2.5x step-up bond before earning verification weight. Cost: honest solos stake 0.22 once; farms face geometric capital drain. Verification: peers match bond receipts to join stamps and reject unpaid clusters within 2 hops. Failure: double-sign or reused nonce burns 55% of the lock to a marble sink and freezes the key for 2 epochs.
